title: Absolutely disaster update
body:
I need the previous version back asap. This version is not only buggy and complex but absolutely horrible and unsafe. Here are the issues:

1. It displays total value of your cash and deposits in the main screen in big font, an absolute privacy and security risk if you are opening the app outside your home or in front of your friend. The previous version did no display the balance till you tap on account on fixed deposit. I open the app in restaurants, shopping places to see latest credit card transaction, credit card limit is exceeded or not, or if the current account has sufficient funds for the incoming cheque. 

2. Now it is difficult to even navigate to your accounts or make money transfer. Money transfer within adcb accounts has been made unnecessarily complex, requiring many more taps, and non intuitive UI, small fonts where you are unable to clearly see the From/to accounts, exchange rate, balance before or after transfer in accounts, blah blah. Previous version had text fonts bigger enough for clarity, even though the version appeared less polished.

3. Scrolling and swiping is buggy, lot of times it hangs when you swipe or scroll. Wonder why these people don’t pre-populate the data before user begins scrolling?

Overall, the previous version was a usable and stable app that initially appeared less polished but worked amazing for all your needs. If any polishing was needed, one could simply polish the previous app while preserving the flow and UI. The current “polished” update is buggy and unusable for my needs.

title: Despicable UI
body:
The services offered by ADCB are commendable. But the mobile app is just pure ugly. It's been more than a year since Apple introduced the tall, notched displays in their X series phones and the app has still not been updated to support such displays. The UI experience is so bad that you don't feel like using the app at all. While the apps of many competitor banks have been updated to be modern and responsive, the ADCB app still feels about a decade old. Time to catch UP ADCB! 

Oh, one more thing! When do you plan to add support for Apple Pay?
